_baselineNote: CNX's default forecast anchors 2026/2027/2028 total production to its guided FY2026 total (605-620 Bcfe, mid 612.5, reaffirmed), held flat forward since CNX did not guide 2027/2028 production. The gas/NGL/oil split derives from CNX's guided FY2026 liquids-mix percentage (7-8%, mid 7.5%) applied to the guided total, then split between NGL and oil using CNX's own Q2 2026 reported NGL:oil ratio (oil is a de minimis ~2.6% of liquids, <0.1% of total production). CNX guides only a single blended cash-unit-cost figure (fully_burdened_cash_cost, $1.15/Mcfe); LOE, gathering/transport, and cash G&A are each proportionally scaled from the Q2 2026 reported mix to reconcile with that guided total. CNX guides an absolute FY2026 NGL price ($24.60/bbl, used directly) and its own NYMEX gas-price planning assumption ($3.55/MMBtu, used as the default Henry Hub input when no live/custom price is supplied -- preferred over the Q2 2026 realized benchmark ($2.89) because it is management's current forward view, the same precedence the RRC reference model applies). Default-forecast EBITDAX ($1,179.8mm) runs ~8.5% below CNX's own guided FY2026 EBITDAX ($1,290mm); the gap is consistent with CNX's separately guided tax-credit (45Z, ~$40mm/yr) and environmental-attribute (~$90mm/yr) monetization, both real cash contributors this engine's standard commodity-revenue model does not capture -- a disclosed, understood limitation, not an error. Net debt declines dollar-for-dollar with cumulative forecast FCF only (no dividends/buybacks/financing modeled).
